description: This Java class is a command handler responsible for processing 'update global configuration' commands in the Fineract project. It uses annotations to define command type and transaction management, and interacts with a service to perform updates.

classes.name: UpdateGlobalConfigurationCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles update commands for global configuration, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by delegating to the GlobalConfigurationWritePlatformService's update method.
